title: Garcinone C Suppresses Tumorsphere Formation and Invasiveness by Hedgehog/Gli1 Signaling in Colorectal Cancer Stem-like Cells.
authors: Zhou, Yimeng; Qiu, Shuai; Kim, Jin Tae; Lee, Seung Beom; Park, Ho Jin; Son, Moon Jeong; Lee, Hong Jin; Chen, Jing
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Garcinone C通过结合Gli1蛋白抑制结直肠癌干细胞，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接计算，但核心是肿瘤干细胞表型与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Hyperactivation of hedgehog signaling occurs in colorectal cancer stem-like cells (CSCs), a rare subpopulation, potentially involved in metastasis, chemotherapy resistance, and cancer relapse. Garcinone C, a xanthone isolated from mangosteen (Garcinia mangostana), suppresses colorectal cancer in vivo and in vitro by inhibiting Gli1-dependent noncanonical hedgehog signaling. Herein, we investigated the effect of garcinone C on cancer stemness and invasiveness in colorectal cancer; Gli1 was noted as pivotal in maintaining stemness and invasiveness in HCT116 and HT29 CSCs. Garcinone C inhibited the proliferation and self-renewal of HCT116 and HT29 CSCs. Colon cancer stemness markers such as CD44, CD133, ALDH1, and Nanog were significantly decreased by garcinone C. Computational studies showed that garcinone C showed a high affinity with the Gli1 protein ZF domain by forming hydrogen bonds with amino acid residues of ASP244, ARG223, and ASP216. Besides, MG132 blocked the effects of garcinone C on Gli1. Thus, garcinone C suppressed colorectal CSCs by binding to Gli1 and enhancing its degradation. MMP2 and MMP9 levels, invasive-related markers, were increased in HCT116 CSCs but decreased by garcinone C. E-cadherin level was reduced in HCT116 CSCs, while the presence of garcinone C was restored. Garcinone C inhibited the proliferation and invasiveness of colorectal CSCs by targeting Gli1-dependent Hh signaling. Garcinone C may be a potent natural agent against colorectal cancer relapse.
abstract_zh: 刺猬信号通路的过度激活发生在结直肠癌干细胞样细胞（CSCs）中，这是一种稀有亚群，可能参与转移、化疗耐药和癌症复发。Garcinone C是一种从山竹（Garcinia mangostana）中分离出的氧杂蒽酮类化合物，通过抑制Gli1依赖的非经典刺猬信号通路，在体内和体外抑制结直肠癌。在此，我们研究了garcinone C对结直肠癌干细胞性和侵袭性的影响；Gli1被发现在维持HCT116和HT29 CSCs的干细胞性和侵袭性中起关键作用。Garcinone C抑制了HCT116和HT29 CSCs的增殖和自我更新。结直肠癌干细胞性标志物如CD44、CD133、ALDH1和Nanog在garcinone C处理后显著降低。计算研究表明，garcinone C通过与ASP244、ARG223和ASP216氨基酸残基形成氢键，与Gli1蛋白ZF结构域表现出高亲和力。此外，MG132阻断了garcinone C对Gli1的作用。因此，garcinone C通过结合Gli1并增强其降解来抑制结直肠癌CSCs。MMP2和MMP9水平（侵袭相关标志物）在HCT116 CSCs中升高，但经garcinone C处理后降低。E-cadherin水平在HCT116 CSCs中降低，而garcinone C的存在使其恢复。Garcinone C通过靶向Gli1依赖的Hh信号通路抑制结直肠癌CSCs的增殖和侵袭性。Garcinone C可能是一种对抗结直肠癌复发的有效天然药物。
